title: v0.9.74 — Welcome to your candy town

blocks.text: The home screen is now a little candy town, with a river, bridge, cottages, fields and strolling residents. Tap the adventure gate, Candy Shop, garden, picnic, pond or starlight landmark to reach the existing activities. Your seeds and petals come from your actual save.

The stage route and story remain below the town. Building labels follow your language, the layout adapts to phones and larger screens, and reduced-motion settings stop the town animations. This update changes the home screen; combat balance and crop timers stay the same.
主頁變成一座糖果小鎮，加入河流、橋、小屋、田地與散步居民。點擊冒險城門、糖果屋、庭院、野餐、池塘或星光地標，就能進入原有玩法；種子與花瓣顯示真實存檔數量。
關卡路線與故事保留在小鎮下方。建築標籤跟隨語言設定，版面適應手機與較大螢幕，減少動態設定會停止小鎮動畫。本次只改首頁，戰鬥平衡與種植倒數維持原樣。

body_html:
English

The home screen is now a little candy town, with a river, bridge, cottages, fields and strolling residents. Tap the adventure gate, Candy Shop, garden, picnic, pond or starlight landmark to reach the existing activities. Your seeds and petals come from your actual save.

The stage route and story remain below the town. Building labels follow your language, the layout adapts to phones and larger screens, and reduced-motion settings stop the town animations. This update changes the home screen; combat balance and crop timers stay the same.

繁體中文

主頁變成一座糖果小鎮，加入河流、橋、小屋、田地與散步居民。點擊冒險城門、糖果屋、庭院、野餐、池塘或星光地標，就能進入原有玩法；種子與花瓣顯示真實存檔數量。

關卡路線與故事保留在小鎮下方。建築標籤跟隨語言設定，版面適應手機與較大螢幕，減少動態設定會停止小鎮動畫。本次只改首頁，戰鬥平衡與種植倒數維持原樣。
